title: 雨の窓辺
description: 雨粒越しの街と静かな室内を収めた、落ち着いた場面転換用の窓辺素材です。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 曇天の柔らかな拡散光。窓外の灯りは小さく抑える
tone.colorTemp: 5200Kの青灰色を基調に、弱い琥珀色を差す
tone.framing: 35mm・目線高・16:9。窓枠を静かな幾何として使う
tone.texture: 濡れたガラス、結露、塗装木部、微細なフィルム粒子

Asset type: cinematic B-roll still for video editing and thumbnails
Primary request: rain-covered apartment window seen from a quiet interior, with a softly blurred residential street beyond; focus on individual droplets and thin streams of water on the glass
Scene/backdrop: modest unoccupied room at blue-hour dawn, wet street and distant window lights outside
Subject: rain droplets on window glass, no living subject
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial photography, natural imperfections, subtle fine film grain
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, eye-level, 35mm lens, medium-wide view, window frame used as quiet geometric structure, restrained negative space
Lighting/mood: soft cool overcast light, 5200K, calm contemplative mood, low contrast, realistic reflections
Color palette: slate blue, charcoal gray, muted amber pinpoints
Materials/textures: wet glass, painted wood, soft condensation, natural dust
Constraints: one coherent real photograph; no people, no faces, no hands, no silhouettes, no readable text, no logos, no brands, no watermark
